## Deferrals read
Read `docs/tickets/DEFERRALS.md` first. Dispositions:
- **DF-S1.26-1 → DONE.** `amend{target: attendance|approval_mode}` now
  apply against a live run with the declared widening gates (the
  invoking session's attendance consulted first;
  `AuthorityWideningRequiresHuman` on unattended widening;
  `approval_mode → bypass` re-reads the manifest's recorded
  `containment.bypass_admissible`); undeclared targets still refuse
  typed (`unknown_amend_target`). Landed at S2.10 rather than the
  S2.12 named in the row — the ticket's own scope pulled the CLI
  Stage-2 slice forward.
- **DF-S1.18-1 — progress note.** The K4 store + AC-R-2.3.4-8's
  admissibility/epoch halves landed; the row's other members (K5,
  turn-loop emitter wiring, `probe_profile`, non-static routing arms,
  the dialect corpus) stay OPEN.
- **DF-S1.18-2 — progress note.** AC-R-2.3.4-9's K4 readers mechanism
  is landed and unit-verified; the H3 fuzz + Stage-3 battery stay.
- **DF-S2.9-3 — progress note.** `env.snapshot` is now a real
  boundary op (a *manual* producer); the automatic cadence stays.
- **DF-S2.10-1 (new, OPEN)** — the unbacked `env` verbs
  (`open`/`attach`/`close`/`diff`/`restore`/`upload`/`download`)
  refuse `stage_pending`, never fake.
- **DF-S2.10-2 (new, OPEN)** — AC-R-2.11.1-16's readers-withholding
  half over CLI output + the LT-01…12 battery stay with S2.12 (the
  AC's owning ticket); no reader-set enforcement is claimed on the
  S2.10 output paths.

## Notable rulings / incidents during the run

- **Env writer ops must not close the takeover session** (ADR-0272
  D6): `close` on a writer session drains the run (`Draining`), so
  `env snapshot/derive/set-phase` keep the session open like
  `run amend`. Caught by
  `env_snapshot_and_derive_over_the_writer_session`.
- **Resumed sessions must rebuild `RealizedSettings` from the
  manifest**: attach/resume was defaulting `approval_mode`, so a
  `plan`-preset run showed `observe_only` after takeover — the session
  projection now derives attendance + effective approval mode from the
  manifest record.
- **Amend widening consults the *invoking* session's attendance**:
  an interactive takeover of an async-parked run may widen — the
  session's stored `async` is only the fallback (ADR-0272 D8).
- **`HH_TRUST_STORE` is process-global in tests**: the two trust tests
  serialize on `TRUST_ENV_LOCK` — parallel store mutation otherwise
  races (observed flake: `trusted` → `unknown`).
- `env.derive` needs the workspace root to exist (fork_snapshot copies
  the tree) — the test creates `ws/` explicitly; the refusal
  (`EnvironmentUnavailable{copy_tree read_dir}`) stays typed, never
  fabricated.
